title: Cruise with Cab and the dilemma of asking Cab instead of Sammy
summary: On a nostalgia cruise with Cab and his wife they reminisced; Jones explains he could not ask Sammy about Glaser's offer, since Sammy might have exploded, and Dance says Sam knew what he was doing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. Well, that's nice. I mean we were very tight about that, so we celebrated our anniversary
last year, and by celebrating it we went on the cruise he was on, you know, a nostalgia cruise. And as I told you, Tedd King, Hildegarde, Peter Duchin and Cab and his daughter.
And you.
